features.name: v1_v2_ratio
features.description: Ratio of first two harmonic amplitudes V1 and V2, capturing relative energy distribution between low-frequency components.
features.expected_model_benefit: Trees can split on harmonic balance which differentiates nasal vs oral phonemes.

features.name: energy_sum_low
features.description: Sum of the first two amplitude features representing low-frequency energy concentration.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single split point for total low-frequency energy.

features.name: energy_sum_high
features.description: Sum of higher-frequency amplitude features V3, V4, V5 capturing upper spectral energy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps tree split on overall high-band amplitude.

features.name: low_minus_high_energy
features.description: Difference between low-band (V1+V2) and high-band (V3+V4+V5) energy sums; indicates spectral tilt.
features.expected_model_benefit: Spectral tilt is a strong indicator for phoneme classification and offers a clean split.

features.name: max_amplitude
features.description: Maximum amplitude across all 5 harmonic features per row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures peak harmonic intensity for threshold-based splits.

features.name: min_amplitude
features.description: Minimum amplitude across all 5 harmonic features per row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies the weakest harmonic, useful for distinguishing voiced/unvoiced sounds.

features.name: amplitude_range
features.description: Spread between maximum and minimum amplitudes across V1-V5.
features.expected_model_benefit: Large dispersion vs small dispersion provides discriminative thresholds for trees.
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(V1, V2), V3), V4), V5)

features.name: monotonic_decreasing_indicator
features.description: Boolean indicator (1/0) whether amplitudes strictly decrease from V1 through V5, a pattern in certain phoneme spectra.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct categorical split for descending spectral shape.

features.name: argmax_position
features.description: Index (1-5) of which harmonic feature has the largest amplitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Position of spectral peak is a strong categorical discriminator for phonemes.

features.name: high_v1_low_v5_pattern
features.description: Interaction indicator for strong V1 amplitude combined with weak V5, characteristic of certain vowel formants.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a specific spectral configuration as a clean binary split.

features.name: spectral_centroid_proxy
features.description: Amplitude-weighted average of harmonic positions 1-5, approximating spectral centroid for the row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures where spectral mass concentrates; tree can threshold to distinguish phoneme groups.
features.formula: (1.0 * np.abs(V1) + 2.0 * np.abs(V2) + 3.0 * np.abs(V3) + 4.0 * np.abs(V4) + 5.0 * np.abs(V5)) / (np.abs(V1) + np.abs(V2) + np.abs(V3) + np.abs(V4) + np.abs(V5) + 0.001)

features.name: nasal_vs_oral_judgment
features.description: Heuristic semantic score expressing how nasal-like the spectral pattern appears: nasals typically have dominant low-frequency energy with damped higher harmonics. Score is high when V1 and V2 dominate while V3-V5 are weak.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes phonetic domain knowledge as a single feature that the tree can threshold for nasal-like vs non-nasal-like rows.
